responsibility: This header is the principal declaration and shared-type interface for the AArch64 backend implementation. It defines backend enums and structs for symbol addressing classes, address-query categories, salting schemes, cost tables, and atomic helper naming, and it declares the major target helper functions spanning address legitimacy, symbol handling, atomics, SIMD/SVE builtin expansion, load/store-pair formation, target attribute processing, speculation and hardening helpers, and AArch64-specific passes, making it the central cross-file API for gcc/config/aarch64 sources.
